# `gcp.task`

A unit of scheduled work.

| Service | cloudtasks |
| Scope | global |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | **no** | the create url `{+parent}/tasks` needs `queue`, which nothing supplies: no provider setting (project, region, zone, location), no stored binding, and no settable attribute of this type |
| Read | yes | `GET {+name}` |
| Update | **no** | publishes no update method; every change to it replaces the resource |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE {+name}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |

## Import id

```
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/queues/{queue}/tasks/{task}
```
